**Chinese name:** 北京地平线机器人技术研发有限公司 (Běijīng Dìpíngxiàn Jīqìrén Jìshù Yánfā Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded July 2015; listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, one of the clearer success cases of a Chinese fabless firm reaching volume automotive design wins without an Entity List designation. Full-year 2025 revenue reached ¥3.758 billion (+57.7% YoY), while R&D spending grew even faster, up 63.3% to ¥5.154 billion — deliberately outspending revenue growth. H1 2026 revenue was ¥2.055 billion (+32.9% YoY) with ¥1.356 billion gross profit.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Automotive-grade processors and the accompanying software platform for intelligent/autonomous driving systems.
